observations.whatHappened:
The proposed route differs from the current coordinated arrangement. The installed supports and neighbouring services should be reviewed together before the route is confirmed.

The review needs to establish the final connection positions, maintenance access and installation sequence. The observation records the issue for coordination; it does not approve a change to scope or cost.

A coordinated response is required so the remaining work can be planned against a single agreed arrangement. Any associated programme or commercial effect should be recorded through the relevant project process.
observations.actionNeeded: Review the proposed route and issue a coordinated instruction before the affected installation proceeds.
